recognize_zh: 組合圖：A 冠狀切 CT 顯示鼻腔與鼻竇大片軟組織腫塊，B 為瀰漫成片的大型異型淋巴細胞，C–E 免疫染色瀰漫強陽性，F 為治療後腫塊明顯消退；形態符合瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤，但 1α-羥化酶與細胞激素產生無法由圖片判定。
features: Panel A: coronal CT with a large soft-tissue mass filling the nasal cavity and paranasal sinuses with bony remodeling
Panel B (H&E): diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei, effacing architecture
Panel C: immunostain with diffuse strong positivity infiltrating between skeletal muscle-like fibers
Panels D-E: diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic positivity in the large-cell infiltrate (antibodies not labeled)
Panel F: follow-up coronal CT with near-complete resolution of the mass
describe_en: Composite figure. Coronal CT (A) demonstrates a large sinonasal soft-tissue mass that has largely resolved on follow-up imaging (F). Biopsy (B) shows diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, and immunostains (C-E) show diffuse strong positivity in the neoplastic cells, including infiltration around muscle fibers; the specific antibodies are not labeled and cannot be identified from the image. The morphology is compatible with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. The claimed 25-hydroxyvitamin D-1α-hydroxylase and cytokine production cannot be confirmed from these panels and requires clinical correlation (hypercalcemia with elevated 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D) and specific immunostains.

ddx.vs: Shows angiocentric necrosis with CD3ε+/CD56+ cytotoxic cells and EBER positivity, rather than CD20+ sheets.
Common in the oral/sinonasal region but is CD20-negative, CD138+/MUM1+ and often EBER+.
Epithelial or neuroendocrine markers (keratin, synaptophysin) are positive and CD45/B-cell markers negative.
Tumor cells express desmin/myogenin rather than lymphoid markers, which matters because panel C shows infiltration among muscle.
